title: Make a controller action
summary: Ruby on Rails: Make a controller action. Change the greeting.
introduction: A route names a controller and action. GET /hello runs LessonController#hello.
learningObjectives: Make a controller action with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Make a controller action
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/hello", to: "lesson#hello"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def hello
 render plain: "Hello, Asha!"
end
end

blocks.text: The route points to lesson#hello. Rails calls that action and renders plain text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The file lesson_controller.rb must define LessonController.
